adjudication.rationale: In the diff, `EmbeddableHost` explicitly strips protocol and path in `before_validation` (`sub!(/^https?:\/\//, '')` and `sub!(/\/.*$/, '')`), and `host_allowed?`/`record_for_host` match only on `URI(...).host` against `where("lower(host) = ?", host)`. In `embed_controller_spec.rb`, fabricating `host: 'https://example.com/1234'` will persist as `example.com` due to the callback, so the test is actually exercising the normalization behavior. If path-stripping regressed (stopped happening), the stored value would remain `'https://example.com/1234'` and the lookup for `example.com` would fail, so the test would *not* still pass as the finding claims.
